risks.title: High dependence on major customers
risks.summary: The company is highly dependent on a few large customers, with two accounting for 40% of sales. The loss or reduction of purchases from a major customer would have a significant negative impact on sales and results.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in 'Our Industry, Operations, and Competition', language is strong ('substantial negative impact', 'material adverse effect'). Concentration on two customers representing 40% of sales in 2025 is significant. This risk is weighted under the 'Competition' category as customer loss may relate to competitive pressures.

risks.title: Intense price competition and margin pressure
risks.summary: The market is highly competitive, forcing the company to lower prices and offer more favorable terms to customers, which reduces margins and profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Highlighted in 'Our Industry, Operations, and Competition' with strong language ('intense price competition', 'material adverse effect'). Price pressure and the need to maintain a competitive cost structure are central. The 'Competition' category is most relevant.

risks.title: Supply chain and supplier risks
risks.summary: Disruptions from suppliers (delays, non-compliance, bankruptcy) or supply chain management issues (raw material costs, tariffs, political instability) could severely impact operations and profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Described in 'Our operations may be materially and adversely affected if our suppliers fail to perform or if we cannot manage our supply chain effectively.' Language is strong ('materially adversely affect'). Dependence on foreign suppliers (77% of purchases) and geopolitical risks (tariffs, instability) are significant.

risks.title: Impact of inflation and logistics costs
risks.summary: Rising inflation in raw material, transportation, and energy costs, along with logistics disruptions, increases operating costs and may reduce profitability if these increases cannot be passed on to customers.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in 'Significant inflation could adversely affect our business and financial results' and 'Our operating results are sensitive to the availability and cost of third-party logistics providers'. Language is strong ('materially adversely affect'). Inflation in input and transportation costs is a major risk.

risks.title: Changes in vehicle quality and warranties
risks.summary: Improvements in new vehicle quality and extended manufacturer warranties reduce the frequency of part replacements, negatively impacting demand for the company's products.
risks.score_rationale: Presented in 'Our Industry, Operations, and Competition' with clear language ('negatively impacted', 'material adverse effect'). Improved new vehicle quality and extended warranties reduce aftermarket parts demand. This risk is industrial as it directly affects the core business.

risks.title: Risks related to excessive customer returns
risks.summary: The product return policy allows customers to return excess inventory. If these returns exceed estimates, it could have a significant negative impact on profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Described in 'Our profitability may be materially adversely affected by customer overstock returns exceeding anticipated levels'. Language is strong ('materially adversely affected'). Returns of non-defective products can significantly impact profitability if provisions are exceeded.

risks.title: Impact of U.S. trade policy changes (tariffs)
risks.summary: Changes in U.S. trade policy, including tariffs on imported goods, increase procurement costs and may reduce demand, negatively affecting results.
risks.score_rationale: Addressed in 'Changes in U.S. trade policy, including tariffs and related actions, could adversely affect our business and results of operations'. Language is strong ('adversely affect'). High reliance on Chinese suppliers (38% of purchases) makes the company vulnerable to import tariffs.

ai_positioning.summary: The company DORM does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
